title: My biggest flex is giving myself grace.
hook: My biggest flex is giving myself grace.
caption:
My biggest flex is giving myself grace.

It’s knowing that I don’t have to follow a standard I never came up with (thanks Hollywood, social media and society)

I used to think if my house didn’t look perfect, I wasn’t wearing a specific size, and I didn’t have a certain image I was “losing”

When really the only thing I lost was myself!

So much freedom came when I took back what winning/success looked like for me.

Now my toes are bare, my floor has crumbs, there’s fingerprints on the class and cat hair on the rug….

And we’re just happy. 

Because I learned to find peace in the little moment

title: Life gives us opportunities to listen in ways we may not always recognize.
hook: Life gives us opportunities to listen in ways we may not always recognize.
caption:
Life gives us opportunities to listen in ways we may not always recognize.

Running has been one of those places for me. It taught me to listen to my body, to know when to push and when to pull back, to recognize what I needed and respond to what I was hearing.

Over time, I began to recognize that same kind of listening everywhere.

Relationships ask something different of us. So do boundaries, home, work and the decisions we make along the way. Each gives us another opportunity to notice what we are hearing, what we are feeling and how we choose to respond.

This is part of what LIVING means

title: Communication with your coach is key. Here’s why.
hook: Communication with your coach is key. Here’s why.
caption:
Communication with your coach is key. Here’s why.

A programme is only as good as the information behind it. If your coach doesn’t know how your week actually went, energy levels, sleep, stress, hunger, they’re adjusting your plan based on guesswork.

The clients who get the best results are the ones who are upfront. Not just when things are going well, but especially when they’re not.

Missed a session? Say so. Struggling with hunger? Say so. Sleep has been terrible? Say so.
